what: The Mac's 7.1 TB volume had 138 MB free at 04:24 local: every command failed with ENOSPC until I deleted my own lane's target/debug (20 GiB). My lane's cargo target directory is 30 GiB and its fixture homes 1 GiB; the rest is not mine.
cost: ten minutes; one fixture run lost
cause: many worktrees each with a target directory
class: a shared resource with no budget
fix: a per-lane target budget, or one shared target directory for cargo-built lanes
